user.title: Nice
user.description: Choose an available connection mode. Local + cloud fallback is recommended when cloud transport is available. Cloud routes are encrypted, but the Nice relay uses a self-signed certificate, so its certificate and hostname cannot be verified.

data_description.connection_mode: How Home Assistant should reach this Nice device. Only modes supported by this version are shown.
data_description.credential_source: Enter NHK credentials manually or import them during a one-time MyNice session.

cloud_auth.title: Import credentials from MyNice
cloud_auth.description: This optional one-time import sends the supplied account details to Nice through the private service and built-in client registration used by MyNice. The service may change. Home Assistant discards the account password and access token after the import.

data.cloud_confirm: I understand this uses a private MyNice service

data_description.cloud_account: Email address or username for the MyNice account.
data_description.cloud_account_password: Used only for this import and never stored in the config entry.
data_description.cloud_confirm: Confirms that you understand the account details leave the LAN and that the MyNice service is private and may change.

cloud_accessories.title: Choose Nice interfaces
cloud_accessories.description: Found {count} unconfigured interface(s). {skipped} incomplete or duplicate record(s) were ignored. Select every interface you want to add.

data_description.cloud_accessories: Each selected interface becomes its own Home Assistant config entry.

cloud_local.title: Connect {name}
cloud_local.description: Configure interface {current} of {total}. The account session has ended; Home Assistant now validates only the imported NHK device credentials through the selected route.

data_description.name: Display name for this gate in Home Assistant.
data_description.host: Address that Home Assistant uses to reach the Nice interface on the local network.
data_description.port: Local Nice interface TLS port. The default is 443.
data_description.relay_host: Internet relay hostname. TLS encrypts relay traffic, but certificate and hostname verification are disabled because the Nice relay uses a self-signed certificate.
data_description.relay_port: Internet relay TLS port. The default is 7890.
data_description.device_id: NHK device ID to control. Leave at 1 unless troubleshooting a different device.
data_description.t4_timeout_ms: Timeout sent inside local T4 requests, in milliseconds.

local.title: Connect Nice
local.description: Enter the NHK device credentials and endpoints required by the selected connection mode. Close MyNice/MyNice Pro before validating a local connection.

list_users.name: List users
list_users.description: Return the users paired to the gate, including any pending pairing requests awaiting approval.

config_entry_id.name: Gate
config_entry_id.description: Which gate to query. Optional when only one Nice IT4WIFI gate is configured.

approve_user.name: Approve user
approve_user.description: Approve a pending user so their phone or fob can control the gate.

username.name: Username
username.description: Name of the pending user to approve, as shown by List users.

config_entry_id.name: Gate
config_entry_id.description: Which gate to act on. Optional when only one gate is configured.

set_user_permission.name: Set user permission
set_user_permission.description: Change a user's role. Admins can manage other users; disable revokes access without removing the pairing.

username.name: Username
username.description: The user whose permission should change.

permission.name: Permission
permission.description: New role: admin, user, or disable.

config_entry_id.name: Gate
config_entry_id.description: Which gate to act on. Optional when only one gate is configured.

delete_user.name: Delete user
delete_user.description: Remove a user's pairing from the gate.

config_entry_id.name: Gate
config_entry_id.description: Which gate to act on. Optional when only one gate is configured.

list_transmitters.name: List transmitters
list_transmitters.description: Return the radio transmitters (remotes) stored in the gate's radio receiver, with their serial, type (mono/bidi), and for each programmed button the gate command it triggers.

config_entry_id.name: Gate
config_entry_id.description: Which gate to query. Optional when only one Nice IT4WIFI gate is configured.

delete_transmitter.name: Delete transmitter
delete_transmitter.description: Remove a stored radio transmitter (all its buttons, or a single button) from the receiver. Returns the removed entries so they can be restored.

serial.name: Serial
serial.description: Transmitter serial: the decimal 'serial' from List transmitters, or a 0x-prefixed hex value.

button.name: Button
button.description: Optional: remove only this button; omit to remove all of the transmitter's buttons.

config_entry_id.name: Gate
config_entry_id.description: Which gate to act on. Optional when only one gate is configured.

add_transmitter.name: Add transmitter
add_transmitter.description: Store a radio transmitter by serial number. Reliable for mono (O-Code) remotes; a bidirectional remote may also require on-site learning.

command.name: Command
command.description: Gate command code: 1=Step by step, 2=Partial opening 1, 3=Open, 4=Close, 5=Stop, 8/9=Partial opening 2/3, ...

round.name: Round
round.description: Rolling-code counter to store (0-65535). Use the value from a previous listing when re-adding a remote that was not reset; 0 for a reset or new remote.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: Record priority bits (0-3). Stored remotes on an OXIBD carry 0.

group_abilitation.name: Group abilitation
group_abilitation.description: Group enable bits (0-15). Stored remotes on an OXIBD carry 12; default 12.

t4_group.name: T4 group
t4_group.description: T4 group nibble (0-15). Stored remotes on an OXIBD carry 0.

config_entry_id.name: Gate
config_entry_id.description: Which gate to act on. Optional when only one gate is configured.

set_transmitter_command.name: Reassign transmitter button
set_transmitter_command.description: Change the gate command a stored transmitter button triggers (deletes and re-adds the entry, preserving its other fields).

command.name: Command
command.description: New gate command code: 1=Step by step, 2=Partial opening 1, 3=Open, 4=Close, 5=Stop, ...

config_entry_id.name: Gate
config_entry_id.description: Which gate to act on. Optional when only one gate is configured.

learn_transmitter.name: Learn transmitter
learn_transmitter.description: Put the gate's radio receiver into learning mode, then press a button on the new remote near the receiver. Returns the transmitter(s) captured. Works for mono and bidirectional remotes and needs no serial number.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: How long to stay in learning mode, in seconds (5-180).

config_entry_id.name: Gate
config_entry_id.description: Which gate to act on. Optional when only one gate is configured.
